description: This file defines the 'Option' class within the OpenCart admin controller event namespace. The class includes methods to hook into option edit and delete events, adding tasks to generate product information data for affected products.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Controller class that responds to option edit and delete events, scheduling tasks related to product info updates.

methods.name: editOption
methods.description: Handles the event after an option is edited, scheduling product info tasks for the related products.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles the event after an option is deleted, scheduling product info tasks for the affected products.
